title: Mission Manifest
description: Schema for a content manifest. Lives at data/singleplayer/campaigns/manifest.json and data/singleplayer/scenarios/manifest.json, and sets the order the folder's content is presented in. Entries are IDs, not folder names. Anything found on disk but absent here is appended, sorted by ID. An archive loaded at higher VFS priority may replace this file to reorder or insert content.

identifier.description: A non-empty string containing only letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens.

$schema.description: Path or URL to the JSON Schema for this file.

campaigns.description: Campaign IDs in presentation order. Must match the 'campaignId' of a campaign.json under data/singleplayer/campaigns/.

scenarios.description: Mission IDs in presentation order, for scenarios under data/singleplayer/scenarios/ — missions that belong to no campaign. Must match the 'missionId' of a mission.json there.
